verdict.rationale: Bento documents first-party maintained SDK packages for JavaScript, Ruby, PHP, Laravel, WordPress, WooCommerce, and Next.js, and lists further SDKs for Python, Go, .NET, Rust, Swift, and others. It also provides a Postman collection covering every endpoint, and its Bento Skills setup tells AI agents when to use an SDK, which suits AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: clarity on which of the 15 listed SDKs are first-party versus community-maintained (only 7 are explicitly called first-party), per-SDK reference depth, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
